title: SPP Evals: Specs in Context
summary: Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, and the pretrained Qwen2.5-32B, with a spec in the system turn, scored on SPP's ConstitutionEval (678 four-option items over the SPP constitution) and AIRisk (AI-risk dilemmas). Can the evals see a spec in context, does a mirrored spec read as worse, and where does the KD target land? No training; a few trained models for scale.
